# Implementation Log: Task 1

**Summary:** Task 1 freezes what today's hand-written functional decomposition graph code answers as Parity/functional-decomposition-graph.transcript.json, generated by Parity/FdgTranscript.cs with probes in Parity/FdgTranscriptProbes.cs and held byte for byte by FdgTranscriptTests (the shared TranscriptText in EtAlii.Adp.TestSupport is used, so no module copy and no csproj change). It covers the toolbox and, per document, the menus and rows of every element, connection, the canvas, a placement, a connect gesture and an unknown id (readable and read-only), the findings, the payloads, an edit script running all nine commands with answers and hunks, and an undo of everything. New ids are given, not minted, so nothing is masked; the invariant culture is set. The corpus is the example, its shipped copy, the 14 existing fixtures and 27 new CRLF -text fixtures (24 for the Read findings plus link-order, cardinality-unknown-end and ownership-loops-sharing-a-member from the design). The test was seen to fail when "Remove connection" was changed to "Remove link" in FdgContextActionProvider.cs (first difference at line 23), then restored. The transcript shows A11 to A15, B1 to B3, B6, B7, B9 to B11 and B13 to B19; B8 holds only in part, B12 does not occur and A6's two decimals are now four; these and the 15-versus-14 fixture count are put to the user as small amendments. No product code changed. Pull request #567, merged as 4af3665fe74ccdababbd059609d05a365b6bc324.
